units.source_text: 薰中纳言想起：今天是最后一次看到这山庄了，

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought that today would be the last time he saw this mountain villa,

units.source_text: 便向各处巡视。

en.t: and so he went around inspecting every part of it.

units.source_text: 但见佛像皆已迁入寺中，剩下的只是尼姑弁君使用的器具。

en.t: He saw that all the Buddhist images had already been moved into the temple, and only the things used by the nun Ben no Kimi remained.

units.source_text: 设想她那孤寂的生涯，十分可怜，

en.t: Thinking of her lonely life, he felt deeply sorry for her,

units.source_text: 不知今后如何度日，便对她说：“这邸宅应当改造了。

en.t: and wondering how she would live from now on, he said to her, "This residence ought to be rebuilt.

units.source_text: 在尚未竣工之前，你可住在那边的廊房中。

en.t: Until the work is finished, you may live in the rooms along that corridor.

units.source_text: 倘有物件欲送京中二小姐，可唤庄屋内人员来此，妥为办理。”

en.t: If there is anything you wish to send to the Second Lady in the capital, call the people from the estate office here and have them arrange it properly."

units.source_text: 又叮嘱她种种细事。

en.t: He also gave her instructions about all sorts of small matters.

units.source_text: 倘是别的侍女，则如此老朽之人，不会受薰中纳言青睐。

en.t: If she had been any other attendant, someone so old and worn would never have attracted Kaoru's favor.

units.source_text: 但此人与众不同，薰中纳言许她晚上睡在近旁，叫她述说往事。

en.t: But this woman was different, and Kaoru allowed her to sleep nearby at night and asked her to tell him stories of the past.

units.source_text: 旁边并无他人，说话可以放心，故弁君也谈到薰中纳言的生父已故柏木权大纳言之事。

en.t: Since no one else was nearby and they could speak freely, Ben no Kimi also talked about Kaoru's real father, the late Kashiwagi, Provisional Major Counselor.

units.source_text: 她说：“权大纳言临终之时，渴望看看大人在襁褓中的姿态，

en.t: She said, "When the Provisional Major Counselor was near death, he longed to see you as an infant wrapped in swaddling clothes,

units.source_text: 那情状我至今还记得起来。

en.t: and I can still remember that scene even now.

units.source_text: 我想不到活到今日，能拜见大人升官晋爵，定是当年勤恳服侍权大纳言而得来的善报。

en.t: I never imagined I would live until today and see you rise in rank and office; surely it is the good reward I gained from serving the Provisional Major Counselor faithfully in those days.

units.source_text: 想起了又是欢喜，又是悲伤。

en.t: When I think of it, I feel both joy and sorrow.

units.source_text: 又念我这苦命人老而不死，看到了许多逆事，便觉可耻而又可恨。

en.t: And when I think that I, an unfortunate woman, have grown old without dying and have seen so many painful reversals, I feel ashamed and bitter.

units.source_text: 二小姐屡次对我说：‘你常常到京中来看看我吧。

en.t: The Second Lady often said to me, 'Please come to the capital often and visit me.

units.source_text: 只管闭居在山中，把我完全抛弃了！’

en.t: You only shut yourself away in the mountains and have completely abandoned me!'

units.source_text: 然而我这不祥之身，除了阿弥陀佛之外，不想拜见别人。”

en.t: But with this ill-omened body of mine, I do not wish to look upon anyone but Amida Buddha."

units.source_text: 便娓娓不倦地叙述大女公子生前情状：什么时候曾说什么话；

en.t: Then she went on tirelessly describing what the elder princess had been like while alive: what she had said at different times,

units.source_text: 欣赏樱花、红叶之时曾咏什么诗歌……虽然声音发抖，倒也说得像模像样。

en.t: and what poems she had composed when admiring the cherry blossoms or the autumn leaves. Though her voice trembled, she spoke with surprising coherence.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听了，设想大女公子为人像小孩一般不多说话，而性情风流优雅。

en.t: Listening to her, Kaoru imagined that the elder princess had been as quiet as a child, yet refined and elegant in nature.

units.source_text: 他听了弁君的话，恋慕之情越发增添，想道：“匂亲王夫人比她姐姐稍稍富有现代风味。

en.t: After hearing Ben no Kimi's words, his longing grew still stronger, and he thought, "Prince Niou's wife has a somewhat more modern air than her elder sister.

units.source_text: 她对于性情不相投合之人，态度很冷淡。

en.t: Toward people whose temperaments do not suit her, she is very cold.

units.source_text: 只有对我深抱同情，愿意和我永结友谊。”

en.t: Only toward me does she feel deep sympathy and wish to form a lasting friendship."

units.source_text: 他在心中如此比较两女公子的性行。

en.t: In his heart, he compared the characters and conduct of the two princesses in this way.
